## The fix

At `0.html:160`, the rule that strips the bottom margin from the last child of `body`, `main`, `li` and similar containers also matched `<dialog>` and `[popover]` elements. Both rely on the browser's `margin: auto` to centre themselves. A modal placed at the end of `<body>`, which is the usual spot, would lose its bottom margin and sit against the bottom of the viewport instead of the centre.

```css
}
```

The `:where()` wrapper keeps the rule's specificity the same as before, so nothing else in the cascade shifts.
